sn56.131:1.1: eva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye pittivisayā cutā devesu paccājāyanti || atha kho eteva bahutarā sattā ye pittivisayā cutā pittivisaye paccājāyanti || Tam kissa hetu || adiṭṭhattā bhikkhave catunnam ariyasaccānaṃ || katamesaṃ catunnam || || Dukkhassa ariyasaccassa || dukkhasamudayassa ariyasaccassa || dukkhanirodhassa ariyasaccassa || dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ariyasaccassa || ||
sn56.131:2.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave Idaṃ dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo || Ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo ti yogo karaṇīyo || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodho ti yogo karaṇīyo || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yogo karaṇīyo ti || ||
sn56.131:3.1: Idam avoca Bhagavā || attamanā te bhikkhū Bhagavato bhāsitam abhinandun ti || || Āmakadhaññapeyyālaṃ || || Cakkapeyyālasamatti || ||
sn56.131:4.0: Uddānam || || Khetta Kayavikkayañca Dūteyyam Tulākūtaṃ Vadhena ca Alopa-Sahasākāram || Appakā te virataṃ || Atha kho eteva Bahutarā sattā || Gatiyo pañcakā so vaggo tena pavuccatī
sn56.131:5.0: ti || || Saccasaṃyuttaṃ dvādasamaṃ || || Magga-Bojjhaṅgaṃ Sati ca Indriyaṃ Sammappadhānañ ca Balañ ca Iddhiyā {Anuruddhaj-Jhāna} Suppakāsitaṃ Sotena Saccha Bhagavā pakāsayi || || Mahāvaggasaṃyuttaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ || ||
